programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP03 Hustler vs. Magician [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kaito goes up against a Syndicate-owned pool hall hustler to win back the Legendary Cue, a treasure once owned by Jii before he was cheated it out of it by the Syndicate boss many years ago. However, things look dire when Jii's pool hall is put on the line and Kaito apparently has no skill with the game.

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP04 A Great Detective Comes to Light [English Dub]
programme.desc: A brilliant if arrogant teen detective comes to town, determined to capture Kid the Phantom Thief. This turns the heat up for Kaito, especially since they're classmates. In fact, Kaito becomes Suguru's rival even out of uniform, leading to a "gentlemen's bet" over which of them will go on a date with Aoko.

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP05 Scarlet Seduction [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kaito has a new classmate, Akako, who appears to possess genuine magic abilities, the kind that bend everyone to her will... except for Kaito and his alter ego, Kid the Phantom Thief! Who will come out on top in the inevitable showdown, sorceress or illusionist?

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP06 Black Star [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kid the Phantom Thief attempts a bold clock tower robbery in a building swarming with the police, but his real rival takes the stage here for the first time, turning the endeavor into a fierce battle of wits!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP07 Kuroba Kaito's Busy Day Off [English Dub]
programme.desc: When Inspector Nakamori catches a glimpse of Kaito's face during an attempted robbery, the young magician has to "prove" he's not Kid the Phantom Thief by going on a date with Aoko at the same time Kid is supposed to make his next appearance!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP08 Adult's Charm [English Dub]
programme.desc: Real magic comes back to haunt Kaito in the form of Akako. This time, the sorceress is so annoyed with her classmate that she plots to wipe him out when he's in his Phantom Thief identity. And to stack the deck, Akako turns Inspector Nakamori into a murderous thug!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP09 Enter: The Phantom Lady [English Dub]
programme.desc: In the present, Kaito and Aoko are lured into a trap at the top of the Toto Tower, while in the past, the first Kid the Phantom Thief and the mysterious Phantom Lady have an exciting first encounter at the top of the Eiffel Tower!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP10 Phantom Lady and the Ryoma Treasure [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kid's first order of business is saving himself and an unconscious, handcuffed Aoko as they plummet from the top of Toto Tower in an antique car. Assuming he succeeds, the next challenge is finishing his mother's last job, bringing a crooked antiques dealer to justice. But his mother never had to deal with the brilliant diminutive detective, Edogawa Conan!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP11 Kid, Conan, and the Ryoma Treasure Illusion [English Dub]
programme.desc: The Detective Conan crossover concludes with a night at the museum, in which Kid goes out of his way to return stolen items amid a crowd of adoring fans, the police who want to take him down, and a couple of real criminals!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP12 Two Kid the Phantom Thieves [English Dub]
programme.desc: When the greedy owner of a department store has an employee impersonate Kid the Phantom Thief to steal the Star of the Giants, he doesn't count on the real Kid showing up on Christmas Eve to foil his plan!

programme.title: Campus Capers 1949
programme.desc: This one features a cat-versus-mouse football game between two cat-and-mouse colleges, called Harbard and Quinceton, and there is nothing Ivy-League about either school. The highlights are a screwy college fight-song and a statute-of-liberty misdirection football play in which the Statute of Liberty participates.

programme.title: Me Musical Nephews 1942
programme.desc: Popeye's nephews have been practicing their music and are getting good, but it's bedtime. After Popeye puts them to bed, they discover that many of the things in their bedroom can also be used to make music. And they are also blessed with an uncanny ability to appear to sleep every time Popeye comes to check on them

programme.title: A Haul in One 1956
programme.desc: Popeye and Bluto are, believe it or not, pals and partners in a moving company. (Maybe it's because Popeye isn't squinting here.) Anyhow, Olive has made the mistake of hiring them. She hasn't finished packing yet, so the boys, smitten as soon as she answers the door, compete to help her. Once packed, they compete to move more impressive piles of her belongings. Popeye easily wins these contests, even though Bluto locks him in the van at one point. At the end, Bluto socks Popeye into the piano, then into a table; though he hardly seems to need it, Popeye still eats his spinach, then thrashes Bluto.

programme.title: Lights Fantastic 1942
programme.desc: A tour of the bright lights of New York City, where the various advertising signs come to life.

programme.title: to duck or not to duck
programme.desc: While Elmer Fudd is hunting fowl, he shoots Daffy Duck. However, Daffy is wearing a bullet-proof vest and only pretends to be wounded

programme.title: Leprechauns Gold 1949
programme.desc: A song-filled Noveltoon featuring the antics of the Irish Leprechauns during their annual gold-washing ceremony. It depicts the wee people of Ireland who flavor its traditions with laughs and legend.

programme.title: Betty Boop with Henry the Funniest Living American-1935
programme.desc: Henry, comic strip character, gets a job at Betty Boop's pet store

programme.title: Parlez Vous Woo 1956
programme.desc: Olive is so captived by "The International", a radio personality with a French accent, that she'd rather stay home than go out on a date with Popeye. Bluto, overhearing this, comes to the door as the character. Popeye does his best to get Olive back, to no avail. Finally, Bluto challenges Popeye to a duel, ultimately stabbing him in the chest where his can of spinach was. Popeye unmasks Bluto, then eats another can of spinach to give himself a French accent.

programme.title: The Crystal Brawl 1957
programme.desc: Bluto muscles out Popeye to take Olive to the fair. Popeye rushes ahead and poses as a fortune teller, luring Olive in. He shows Olive her future (actually, her past) in the crystal ball: first, a clip of a mountain climbing sequence that culminates in Bluto assaulting Olive. Then, a clip from another amusement park showing strongman Bluto stealing Olive away to a roller-coaster while Popeye rings a strength-testing bell repeatedly. Olive, having seen this, no longer wants anything to do with Bluto and walks out. Bluto exposes Popeye and chases Olive into a Tunnel of Love; Popeye follows and trashes Bluto.

programme.title: Noah's Ark 1959
programme.desc: Noah gets the word: build an ark in seven days. His sons cut the necessary trees in three days, and much furious sawing and hammering follows. But there's no rest, as they need to round up all the animals. Noah boards the animals, then his sons, their wives, and his wife (who packed a ferocious picnic). The rains and flood begin. The animals soon develop cabin fever and get restless, but Mrs. Noah has the answer: "Music has charms to soothe the savage beast." His sons find instruments and begin playing; everyone dances. But Harry the hippo dances with everyone but his wife; Noah goes to her, and while she tells him not to mention Harry's name, Noah convinces her that Harry is thinking only of her. The rains end; Noah sends a dove out who brings back an olive branch. They land on Mount Ararat and disembark.

programme.title: Little Lambkin- 1940
programme.desc: A precocious toddler, wanting to return to his watermelon patch and a pair of animal friends in the country, tampers with the electronic gadgets in his new city home and creates chaos.

programme.title: Felix Gets Broadcasted-1923
programme.desc: Felix spots a fisherman on his way to his fishing spot, and figures he can follow the guy and grab a quick lunch by stealing his catch. Although he successfully nabs a few fish, the angler catches on and finally captures Felix. To get his revenge, he sends Felix through the telephone wires ("broadcasted") to Egypt, and Felix finds out that the Egyptians don't want him there, either.

programme.title: Ride Him, Bosko -1931
programme.desc: BosKo in the Wild West, tries to have fun with any situation that come in his way.

programme.title: Bride and Gloom
programme.desc: Popeye is marrying Olive tomorrow; he's ecstatic. She has a dream of the future, including twin sons who prove to be a real handful. When Popeye comes by the next morning, he gets a frosty reception

programme.title: Spree Lunch 1957
programme.desc: Popeye opens a diner; Bluto pulls one up right across the street. Wimpy comes along, and they compete for his business. The competition escalates, until finally they are throwing things at each other; Wimpy stands between them and snags a complete meal from the stream of objects passing overhead. Another spinach-free Popeye.

programme.title: The Draft Horse 1942
programme.desc: A farm horse tries to enlist in the army, but despite his virtuoso display of wartime histrionics, he's rejected when he flunks the physical. Dejected, he wanders into a mock battlefield, which tells him what war is really like.

programme.title: A Ham in a Role 1949
programme.desc: A Shakespearian dog, tired of being a pie-in-the-face looney tune, quits Warner Brothers to study dramatic acting and goes to his country house to practice the bard. He finds that two polite twin gophers have taken over his abode and angrily throws them out. They retaliate by violently heckling him in comical accordance with his Shakespeare speeches.

programme.title: Molly Moo-Cow and the Indians-1935
programme.desc: A Native American hunter tries to hunt two ducks. A cow saves them, so the hunter goes after the cow

programme.title: Betty Boop- More Pep- 1936
programme.desc: In a return to the 'Out of the Inkwell' format, Betty Boop invents a 'pep' formula to speed up lazy Pudgy, but it escapes into the 'real world' with rapid results.

programme.title: Cookin' with Gags 1955
programme.desc: The boys are taking Olive on a picnic. It's April 1, and Bluto plays a series of "jokes" on Popeye, though of course they go beyond the bounds of acceptability, particularly once they get to the picnic grounds; Bluto puts gasoline on the fire he asks Popeye to light and swaps a beehive for the lemonade. Bluto then launches a cruel joke against Olive and frames Popeye. The capper: he replaces Popeye's spinach with a joke can, and runs off with Olive for some canoeing. But Popeye gets the last laugh with an inflatable sea monster.

programme.title: Play Safe -1936
programme.desc: A little boy jumps on a real train and learns a lesson about safety.

programme.title: Broom Stick Bunny 1956
programme.desc: Witch Hazel's claim to be the ugliest witch of all is threatened by a Halloween witch who turns out to be Bugs trick-or-treating.

programme.title: Out to Punch 1956
programme.desc: Popeye's training for his boxing match with Bluto by jumping rope with a massive chain. Bluto, who's lazy about everything except sabotage, decides he needs to stop Popeye. He fills Popeye's heavy bag with iron junk, but Popeye punches it over the fence onto Bluto. Next, he pulls on the springs attached to the wall with a motorcycle, but Popeye pulls so hard he throws Bluto and the cycle through the building and into a well. Popeye is walking -- or actually, prancing -- behind Olive on the way to the match, so Bluto tries a bit more sabotage: first an oil slick, which slows Popeye down briefly, then some quick-dry cement in a puddle. This gives Popeye cement overshoes, and when he gets to the arena, he's exhausted. Olive stands him up, but Bluto treats him like a punching bag. He's got Popeye on the floor (under the ring), so Olive finally breaks out the spinach. Popeye knocks Bluto through the roof, right into the hospital. The photographers ask for a picture, and Popeye's biceps form the words

programme.title: The Hole Idea 1955
programme.desc: A scientist invents the portable hole, only to have a thief steal his samples to go on a crime spree.

programme.title: Raw! Raw! Rooster 1956
programme.desc: Foghorn's annoying college buddy, Rhode Island Red, comes for a visit and then won't leave. What's worse, he muscles in on Foggy's harem and reverses most of Foggy's traps and tricks. A football session with an exploding casaba melon backfires when Red returns the pass; the exploding golf balls only explode when Foghorn hits them, and the fist in the camera only pops out when Foggy examines it to figure out what went wrong. But Foghorn finally gets the last laugh with a phony telegram about an inheritance and an exploding bowling ball as a parting gift.

programme.title: Popeye's 20th Anniversary 1954
programme.desc: Popeye is being honored for his 20 years of films, in a dinner hosted by 'Bob Hope' (several other celebrities are present, like 'Jimmy Durante', Bing Crosby, 'Jerry Lewis' and 'Dean Martin'). When called on to make a speech, he instead shows clips from two of his movies. Bluto does a slow burn through this, finally stuffing Popeye's trophy onto Popeye's head - but the trophy is full of spinach, so Popeye clobbers Bluto.

programme.title: A Date to Skate 1938
programme.desc: Popeye takes Olive roller skating in a rink; she's never skated before, so he has to teach her, and she's not exactly a quick learner. After a while, she ends up outside the rink, and still out of control; she skates through a department store and causes major traffic problems. When she gets stuck on a speeding fire truck, Popeye realizes he'll need his spinach, but he's out fortunately, an audience member tosses him a can.

programme.title: popeye meets ali baba's forty thieves (1080)
programme.desc: Popeye the Sailor, accompanied by Olive Oyl and Wimpy, is dispatched to stop the dreaded bandit Abu Hassan and his force of forty thieves

programme.title: April Maze-1930
programme.desc: Felix the Cat and his two nephews try to have a picnic, but a thunderstorm and a thieving rabbit prevent them.

programme.title: Much ado About Nutting 1953
programme.desc: A squirrel in a downtown park lugs a giant coconut back home, but nothing he does can seem to crack it open.

programme.title: The Mummy Strikes 1943
programme.desc: While investigating an egyptologist's mysterious death, Superman must battle dangerous mummies.

programme.title: Betty Boop- Whoops! I'm a Cowboy-1937
programme.desc: Betty Boop's runt of a suitor thinks he'll have better luck if he takes cowboy lessons at a dude ranch; slapstick results.

programme.title: Goo Goo Goliath 1954
programme.desc: An inebriated stork must deliver a baby to a giant at the top of a beanstalk, but doesn't feel like flying that high and instead delivers the baby to a normal-sized couple, who try to raise the giant tot as their own.

programme.title: Gold Rush Daze 1939
programme.desc: A man stops for gas on his way to dig for gold. The man at the station tells him what it was like back in 1849 in San Francisco, which we see. A sucker is hauled off the street and sat down at a card game; he dashes off as soon as someone shouts "they found gold in the hills" but others stake claims before he can. He ends up chopping off a cliff, falling down, and landing in the hospital. The doctor gives him news of another gold strike and he rushes out to begin panning. After some more mining gags and a song, we see a montage of more failed gold strikes. Back to the present day, where the storyteller claims to have sworn off gold, until a rider passes through with news of another strike, when he trades the station for the car and sets out after the gold.

programme.title: Boom Boom-1936
programme.desc: World War I, apparently. There is a series of quick blackout gags, including a soldier that throws the pin, is blown sky-high by the grenade, and is caught in a net by an ambulance driver; one soldier's encounters with very smart bullets; a machine gunner with the jitters. Porky leads a charge, but with no support from his company, he runs back and dives under Beans' bunk. After a quick chorus of "You're in the Army Now," a messenger pigeon drops in with news that General Hardtack is being held prisoner. They dash off in a motorcycle/sidecar, chased by another smart bullet, and arrive in the nick of time to dispatch the general's captors. They fly off in a plane and get shot down to end up together in the hospital.

programme.title: Ancient Fistory 1953
programme.desc: It's the middle ages (sort of); Popeye is working in Bluto's Beanery. Bluto is going to the ball where Princess Olive will choose her mate. Popeye's fairy godpappy appears and it's a reverse Cinderella story, with a car created from a can of spinach.

programme.title: The Paneless Window Washer 1937
programme.desc: On the outside of an office building, Popeye and Bluto duke it out as rival window washers.

programme.title: cartoon classics promo final
programme.desc: cartoon classics promo final

programme.title: The Henpecked Rooster 1944
programme.desc: A henpecked rooster and a streetwise mouse team up to thwart the fowl's foul wife.

programme.title: Boo Moon
programme.desc: Casper emerges from a subway station, following a crowd of scared strangers. He encounters a man saying "see the wonders of the moon for ten cents," and offering a sight through a telescope. Casper scares the man away, then uses the telescope to see the moon. He then flies to the moon for a visit. Casper lands on the moon, disappointed to find no man on the moon. He lies down to nap, then tiny moon men emerge from holes. They capture Casper, like Lilliputians did to Gulliver, then place him in a cage on wheels, in which they tow him to the Ruler of the Moon, King Luna. The King addresses Casper as a monster, and treats him as an enemy. Casper playfully picks up King Luna, and the king has him placed in the royal dungeon. A dejected Casper is imprisoned. Then animated trees attack the city of the moon men. The moon men defend their fortified city with flaming missiles. The tree monsters fight back with water, then break through the town walls. When the fight seems lost to the tree monsters, Casper escapes his cage, and helps the moon men. Casper goes underground. The friendly ghost then pulls trees' parts through the moon surface and ties them together, immobilizing the trees. The frustrated trees writhe and strain against the knots Casper has tied. Casper and the moon men have won. Then, and only then, does King Luna embrace Casper as a friend. King Luna knights Casper for the valiant defense of his people. Then all the moon men join in singing the Casper theme song.

The highlights are a screwy college fight-song and a statute-of-liberty misdirection football play in which the Statute of Liberty participates.

programme.title: Betty Boop- More Pep- 1936
programme.desc: In a return to the 'Out of the Inkwell' format, Betty Boop invents a 'pep' formula to speed up lazy Pudgy, but it escapes into the 'real world' with rapid results.

programme.title: to duck or not to duck
programme.desc: While Elmer Fudd is hunting fowl, he shoots Daffy Duck. However, Daffy is wearing a bullet-proof vest and only pretends to be wounded

programme.title: Felix Doubles for Darwin- 1924
programme.desc: A famished Felix reads an advertisement telling of a large reward for anyone that can give proof for the theory of evolution. He hurries to South Africa via Transatlantic Cable and interacts with the local animals. He angers a troop of monkeys by telling them why he's there (they're offended he would suggest they could be related to humans) and they chase him back through the cable to America

programme.title: Popeye for President
programme.desc: Popeye and Bluto are running for president; it's election day, the vote is tied, and Olive is the only remaining voter

programme.title: Betty Boop- Buzzy Boop 1938
programme.desc: Betty's young cousin, Buzzy, takes the train to visit Betty. On the train, she's helpful, in a bratty kind of way, using her chewing gum to stick on a sleeping man's toupee, watering the flowers in a lady's hat, etc. At Betty's house, she sees the boys next door playing marbles and tries to join in; she proves better at things like walking on a fence than the boys, and even fares well with the goat the boys unleash

programme.title: Superman cartoons 3
programme.desc: Superman cartoons 3

programme.title: Felix Lends a Hand 1922
programme.desc: Trudging through the snow in his hometown, Felix sees a billboard advertising sunny Egypt, and says that he'd give four of his nine lives to be there rather than freezing in the snow. He then hears crying coming from his friend Abdul's carpet shop, and it turns out that Abdul's girlfriend has been kidnapped by an Egyptian sheik. Felix promises to rescue her, and hops on a magic carpet Abdul has lying around the shop, says the magic word and flies off to Egypt to keep his promise.

programme.title: Tulips Shall Grow 1942 (madcap models no. u1-5)
programme.desc: A carefree boy and a young girl find their idyllic countryside invaded by an army of mindlessly destructive robots.

programme.title: Superman: Billion Dollar Limited-1950
programme.desc: Superman battles train robbers seeking to steal a billion dollars worth of gold.

programme.title: Space Transformer 1985
programme.desc: Using new technology, a crew consisting of Captain Chi, Nancy, and the robots Baipam and Diatron 5, is shrunken to microscopic size and injected into Ivy's body in order to defeat the invaders. Enlisting benevolent beings found inside Ivy's body, the crew prepares for an inner space battle that can decide the fate of the world.

programme.title: Bride and Gloom
programme.desc: Popeye is marrying Olive tomorrow; he's ecstatic. She has a dream of the future, including twin sons who prove to be a real handful. When Popeye comes by the next morning, he gets a frosty reception

programme.title: Betty Boop's Museum
programme.desc: Koko takes Betty to the museum, where she's locked in overnight and forced to sing at the skeletons' dance

programme.title: Lights Fantastic 1942
programme.desc: A tour of the bright lights of New York City, where the various advertising signs come to life.

programme.title: Baby Buggy Bunny 1954
programme.desc: Baby-faced Finster robs a bank, but the baby carriage with the money in it goes down Bugs' rabbit hole.

programme.title: The Booze Hangs High-1930
programme.desc: Bosko has a grand time on the farm, dancing with a cow, playing a horse's tail like a violin and getting drunk with three pigs

programme.title: Molly Moo-Cow and The Butterflies -1935
programme.desc: Molly Moo-Cow and The Butterflies

programme.title: Secret Agent 1943
programme.desc: Superman battles saboteurs determined to stop a lady double agent from getting important documents to Washington D.C.

programme.title: Crowing Pains 1947
programme.desc: Foghorn convinces Henery that Sylvester is a chicken. Foghorn sticks Henery in an egg and sticks it under Sylvester.

programme.title: Felix the Ghost Breaker-1923
programme.desc: Felix is trying to get some sleep in a graveyard, but keeps getting bothered by a ghost. He follows the ghost to the house of an old farmer, and the ghost proceeds to terrorize the old man, and when the farmer calls for help from the police, the ghost terrorizes them, too. Felix, however, suspects something fishy is going on, and with the help of the farmer's donkey, gets to the bottom of things.

programme.title: Me Feelins is Hurt 1940
programme.desc: Olive writes a letter to Popeye: she's through with sailors; it's cowboys for her. Popeye immediately sails off to the West, where he finds, who else, Bluto as the head of the ranch where Olive is enthralled. Bluto gives Popeye a wild horse to ride, and, after a few humiliating defeats, Popeye conquers it (and wins back Olive's heart). Bluto punches Popeye out, and into the clutches of what can best be described as a rattlesnake constrictor. Bluto then starts menacing Olive, so Popeye eats his spinach, saves her, and defeats Bluto and his gang.

programme.title: Leprechauns Gold 1949
programme.desc: A song-filled Noveltoon featuring the antics of the Irish Leprechauns during their annual gold-washing ceremony. It depicts the wee people of Ireland who flavor its traditions with laughs and legend.

programme.title: Cookin' with Gags 1955
programme.desc: The boys are taking Olive on a picnic. It's April 1, and Bluto plays a series of "jokes" on Popeye, though of course they go beyond the bounds of acceptability, particularly once they get to the picnic grounds; Bluto puts gasoline on the fire he asks Popeye to light and swaps a beehive for the lemonade. Bluto then launches a cruel joke against Olive and frames Popeye. The capper: he replaces Popeye's spinach with a joke can, and runs off with Olive for some canoeing. But Popeye gets the last laugh with an inflatable sea monster.

programme.title: Quack a Doodle Doo 1950
programme.desc: His Mama is the only one who love Baby Huey, an overgrown clumsy ugly duckling. The other Mamas and their broods shun him like the plague and make his little life miserable. But when a ferocious fox attacks the barnyard, Huey comes to the rescue of one and all. Huey is a hero basking in his new-found popularity. First of the series.

programme.title: Trolley Ahoy-1936
programme.desc: Mr. Bang bets the Skipper ten dollars he can't get the trolley to arrive at the train station on time.

programme.title: Taxi Turvy 1945
programme.desc: On the outside of an office building, Popeye and Bluto duke it out as rival window washers.

programme.title: The Star of Bethlehem956
programme.desc: A nativity story animated with music performed by the Glyndeboume Festival Chorus.

programme.title: Noah's Ark 1959
programme.desc: Noah gets the word: build an ark in seven days. His sons cut the necessary trees in three days, and much furious sawing and hammering follows. But there's no rest, as they need to round up all the animals. Noah boards the animals, then his sons, their wives, and his wife (who packed a ferocious picnic). The rains and flood begin. The animals soon develop cabin fever and get restless, but Mrs. Noah has the answer: "Music has charms to soothe the savage beast." His sons find instruments and begin playing; everyone dances. But Harry the hippo dances with everyone but his wife; Noah goes to her, and while she tells him not to mention Harry's name, Noah convinces her that Harry is thinking only of her. The rains end; Noah sends a dove out who brings back an olive branch. They land on Mount Ararat and disembark.

programme.title: Sintel -2010
programme.desc: In this epic fantasy tale, Sintel - a young lonely girl - finds companion in a wounded baby dragon, in the streets of a city in decay

programme.title: Jungle Drums 1943
programme.desc: Superman vs. a secret Nazi outpost disguised as a jungle temple.

programme.title: Felix Gets Broadcasted-1923
programme.desc: Felix spots a fisherman on his way to his fishing spot, and figures he can follow the guy and grab a quick lunch by stealing his catch. Although he successfully nabs a few fish, the angler catches on and finally captures Felix. To get his revenge, he sends Felix through the telephone wires ("broadcasted") to Egypt, and Felix finds out that the Egyptians don't want him there, either.

programme.title: Tulips Shall Grow 1942
programme.desc: A carefree boy and a young girl find their idyllic countryside invaded by an army of mindlessly destructive robots.

programme.title: Little Boy Blue 1936
programme.desc: The Big Bad Wolf stalks Little Bo Peep and steals one of her sheep. She enlists Little Boy Blue and a dancing scarecrow to assist her and her mischievous black sheep in rescuing it. Singing, dancing, hilarity and impalement ensue.

programme.title: Popeye Meets Sinbad the Sailor 1936
programme.desc: The legendary sailors Popeye and Sindbad do battle to see which one is the greatest.

programme.title: A Cartoonist's Nightmare 1935
programme.desc: A cartoonist falls victim to the very villains he has drawn. It's up to Beans the Cat to save the day.

programme.title: Pots and Pans -1932
programme.desc: Tom and Jerry own a restaurant, and have a hard time keeping up with the customers

programme.title: Goo Goo Goliath 1954
programme.desc: An inebriated stork must deliver a baby to a giant at the top of a beanstalk, but doesn't feel like flying that high and instead delivers the baby to a normal-sized couple, who try to raise the giant tot as their own.

programme.title: Felix Goes A-Hunting-1923
programme.desc: A wife throws her husband out of the house, telling him not to return unless he brings her a fur coat. Deciding that the only way he'll get one is to make his own, he grabs his rifle and goes hunting. All his efforts fail, though, until he meets Felix, who offers to help him shoot rabbits, and impresses the man with his marksmanship skills. However, it turns out that shooting the rabbits isn't quite as easy as they thought it would be.

programme.title: Betty Boop- Whoops! I'm a Cowboy-1937
programme.desc: Betty Boop's runt of a suitor thinks he'll have better luck if he takes cowboy lessons at a dude ranch; slapstick results.

programme.title: Space Thunder Kids 1991
programme.desc: Three children pilots fight against the Dark Empire on their mission to destroy the universe.

programme.desc: Rosemary Barton delivers a weekly dose of compelling conversations and need-to-know political news and issues affecting Canadians.

programme.desc: The oldest and most-watched newsmagazine on television gets the real story on America's most prevalent issues. CBS News correspondents contribute segments to each hourlong episode. The correspondents and contributors include Lesley Stahl, Scott Pelley, Anderson Cooper, Bill Whitaker, Sharyn Alfonsi, Jon Wertheim and Norah O'Donnell .

The program offers the latest headlines, original reporting and in-depth pieces that add context and perspective to the world's events.

programme.desc: Diane's Allergy: After moving in with Frasier, Diane develops a chronic allergy that she thinks is caused by his dog. But is her reaction psychosomatic? (S3 Ep10/25)

programme.title: The beat of the city: Inside China's booming Livehouse scene
programme.desc: From the intimate jazz vibes of Beijing's Blue Note to the electric energy of a Guangzhou livehouse — we dive into China's booming nightlife scene. Discover how these venues are more than just places for a night out — they're cultural hubs where young audiences connect, artists innovate, and the city's heart beats to a brand new rhythm.

programme.title: Life as a Miao Silversmith
programme.desc: In this episode, Eva May steps into Maliao Village — a century-old silversmith village nestled in Leishan, Guizhou Province. Over the course of a week, she dives into the craft and daily lives of Miao men who carry on the silversmithing legacy. She works side by side with local silversmiths day in and day out, delving into the culture and techniques behind Miao silverware. She even joins master silversmiths for a live-stream event, before engaging in discussions with university professors about how traditional craftsmanship can fuel rural revitalization. On top of that, she witnesses the breathtaking sight of "maidens adorned in silver and flowers" at the grand Miao New Year celebrations, visits Xijiang Qianhu Miaozhai — the world’s largest Miao village — and learns to forge a small yet meaningful piece of Miao silver ornament.

programme.title: Dive into the world of foreign talent in China's movie industry
programme.desc: We go behind the scenes of China's fast-evolving film industry with foreign actors making their mark here. From script study to on-set cultural moments, they share how they learn, interpret, and help bring Chinese stories to life. Their journeys highlight not only China's growing appeal and openness but also the vibrant, two-way cultural exchange unfolding on the global stage.

programme.title: New Year with the Miao
programme.desc: In this episode, it’s Miao New Year, and that means multitudes of merrymaking! Fishing, drinking, bullfighting… Join the host Min-Zhui Lee, among the magnificent mountains of Leishan, where it’s all happening for the ethnic Miao.

programme.title: Personalized tours draw more global travelers to Beijing
programme.desc: As China’s visa-free policy continues to attract visitors from around the world, more international tourists are choosing customized experiences in Beijing. Local guides fluent in multiple languages are helping them discover the city in their own way. Reporter Li Qiong joined oneone of the capital’s most popular guides to see how personalized tours are reshaping travel in China.

programme.title: Valentine's with the Snake King
programme.desc: Every year on Qixi Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day), the town of Zhanghu in Nanping, Fujian Province hosts a folk custom event: the Snake King Parade. Local residents carry the statue of the Snake King from the temple, along with specially prepared pythons, and parade through the streets and alleys. Wherever the procession passes, residents and shopkeepers greet them with firecrackers and burn incense to pray, hoping to receive the unique blessing of the Snake King. This distinctive folk activity is rarely seen elsewhere across China. Taking this event as its highlight, the episode leads audiences on a deep dive into the towns and villages of northern Fujian, delivering a highly engaging and visually appealing viewing experience.

programme.title: From plush toys to holograms: The growing world of AI companionship
programme.desc: Artificial intelligence is evolving—from answering our questions to keeping us company. From robotic pets in our neighborhoods to holographic characters that sense our mood, AI companionship is stepping out of science fiction and into everyday life. What does this mean for human relationships and the future of connection itself? Reporter Zhang Hong explores the rise of these new companions.

programme.title: An Encounter with China’s Endangered Monkeys
programme.desc: In this episode, we head to Baima Snow Mountain Nature Reserve in Diqing Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, to learn about and participate in the conservation work for the rare and precious national treasure: the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. The presenter ventures into the forest, experiences the daily life of local forest rangers, and witnesses the harmonious relationship between humans and monkeys. We interview "the Monkey Father"—Long Yongcheng, chief scientist of The Nature Conservancy (TNC) and leader of China's Primate Expert Group—who shares stories about the two decades of efforts dedicated to protecting the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. We also go to the mountains to conduct research alongside young volunteers. Through these activities, we recognize the importance of environmental education for young people in promoting natural ecological balance and harmonious development.

programme.title: Young Chinese dare to express their culture
programme.desc: A fresh chapter in cultural storytelling is being written by young Chinese around the world. Young Chinese are amplifying tradition through trend, donning hanfu not only in historical lanes but in everyday life, and weaving those visuals into the fabric of social media. Our reporter Ioana Gomoi meets the creators who are turning heritage into a trendy cultural inspiration.

programme.title: World Heritages in China: A Journey on Water from Wuxi to Yixing
programme.desc: Water has always been the heartbeat of human civilization, nurturing the cities it weaves through. From the first drops that carved out its waterways to the thriving metropolis we see today, Wuxi’s story is inseparable from the grand canal. This is the story of a city born of water. In this episode, we uncover how the waters have shaped Wuxi’s identity.

programme.title: LIVING THE NEW WAVE China's livestream shopping boom redefines e-commerce
programme.desc: Now, we’re taking you inside one of China’s most dynamic phenomena—the livestream shopping revolution. From the misty tea mountains of Guizhou to Beijing’s glittering jewelry studios, millions tune in daily not just to purchase, but to connect. How did this fusion of entertainment and e-commerce become such a powerful cultural force? And what does it tell us about the future of shopping worldwide? Our reporter Lucy Lyv is here with us.

programme.title: Ding Porcelain Firing
programme.desc: In ancient times, skilled craftsmen combined clay with fire and, using nothing more than their hands and wisdom, created the history of porcelain. A thousand years ago, at the time of the Northern Song Dynasty, a type of porcelain was produced that stood out for its exquisite quality, elegant coloring and beautiful patterns. This was Ding porcelain, and it became a favorite at the imperial court. However, within 200 years, amid the chaos of constant warfare, the art of making it was lost. The dazzling white light of the Ding kilns had faded, seemingly forever. And yet, 800 years later, that light has been reignited.

programme.title: INVESTING IN JOY: Inside China's new emotional economy
programme.desc: Today's young Chinese generation are driving a new "emotional economy," spending not just on necessities but on feelings. From trendy toys that offer joy and community, to serene scents that provide a moment of peace – they are investing in personal well-being, reshaping the consumer landscape.

programme.title: Quyang Stone Carving
programme.desc: Quyang is known as a hometown of Chinese carving. Quyang's stone carving works are popular around different parts of China, thus also exported to over 100 countries and regions worldwide. The style of Quyang stone carving both carries the mysterious and rough spirit of the Wei Dynasty and the natural and graceful forms of the Tang and Song dynasties. It reflects the life experiences and live philosophies of local artisans. Each statue's showcases unique oriental aesthetics.

programme.title: The Inner Horizon: China's extreme sports revolution
programme.desc: They say in China, the most exciting frontiers aren't always on a map. A new cultural wave is sweeping the nation, turning vertical rock faces, open skies, and dense forests into new playgrounds. What was once the domain of a handful of adventurers is now a booming lifestyle for millions of young Chinese. I recently ventured out to explore why extreme sports are becoming the new national pastime, and what this reveals about the changing spirit of China.

programme.title: Echoes of Green
programme.desc: Echoes of Green takes viewers deep into Anji’s bamboo forests and mountain villages, where a new generation of Chinese youth is redefining how to live with nature. Through stories of outdoor sports, forest cafés, tea rituals, and family farms, the series shows how ecological ideals have become everyday choices and creative lifestyles. It is not just about landscapes, but about people — young dreamers proving that prosperity and nature can grow side by side, and that culture gives life to sustainability.

programme.title: An Echo of Antiquity: The Enduring Charm of Kunqu
programme.desc: Kunqu Opera, the "ancestor of a hundred operas," condenses its 600-year essence. From its melodious and captivating vocals to its elegant and delicate movements, we will explore the unique charm of this ancient performing art and the profound cultural heritage behind it.

programme.title: From bean to cup: The rise of China’s specialty coffee
programme.desc: Pu’er — a city named after tea — is now at the center of another brewing story: China’s fast-rising coffee industry. From mountain farms to urban cafés, a new generation of growers and coffee professionals is bringing China’s specialty coffee onto the global stage. What makes Yunnan’s coffee region unique? How are farmers, industry professionals, and consumers shaping a new coffee ecosystem in China? Join us as we explore how China’s coffee culture is evolving — from origin to cup.

programme.title: A Vibe of the Village: The Beat of Xiangxi Drums
programme.desc: Experience the vibrant power of Xiangxi Drum Dance. This program delves into the heart of Tujia and Miao cultures, showcasing the rhythmic beats and spirited performances that have echoed through West Hunan's mountains for centuries. Discover the stories, traditions, and raw energy of this captivating folk art.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise. Kleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals

programme.title: Wudang Martial Arts and Taichi
programme.desc: Join host Yegor on a journey into the heart of China’s Wudang Mountains—the spiritual cradle of Taoism and the birthplace of Wudang martial arts. Through in-depth conversations with renowned masters such as Zhong Xueyong, Cai Chongguang, Jake Pinnick, and Liu Xiang, this episode explores the philosophy, techniques, and living spirit of Wudang Quan and Taichi. From the internal cultivation of qi to the harmony between body and mind, Wudang martial arts are more than just physical training—they are a way of life rooted in the Tao. Alongside martial techniques, the program also delves into traditional Chinese music, calligraphy, and medicine, revealing how these disciplines come together in the pursuit of balance, self-awareness, and longevity. This is not just a story of punches and postures, but of tradition, transformation, and the timeless search for harmony between humans and the universe.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun

programme.title: Wudang Martial Arts and Taichi
programme.desc: Join host Yegor on a journey into the heart of China’s Wudang Mountains—the spiritual cradle of Taoism and the birthplace of Wudang martial arts. This is not just a story of punches and postures, but of tradition, transformation, and the timeless search for harmony between humans and the universe.

programme.title: Lost Cities of The Ancients

programme.title: Walking with Beasts
programme.desc: Special effects-filled documentary beginning 49 million years ago. The world is heavily forested and birds rule the planet, preying on small mammals. Whales have not yet evolved and their ancestors walk on the land.

programme.desc: A pregnant basilosaurus, an 18-metre, carnivorous whale which lives in the Tethys Sea, is forced to kill the young of a smaller whale to ensure the survival of her unborn calf.

programme.title: Walking with Beasts
programme.desc: Going back 25 million years to the time of the indricothere, which was the largest mammal ever to live on dry land, being seven metres high and weighing 15 tons! The only threat to an adult would have been the hyaenadon which was the size of a rhino.

programme.title: Walking with Beasts

programme.title: Walking with Beasts
programme.desc: Revealing the exotic, oversized creatures that inhabited South America one million years ago, such as the deadly smilodon, the largest of all sabre tooth cats.

programme.sub-title: Why is there a black market for refrigerants in the EU, and how does it work?
programme.desc: Reforms to phase out the most polluting gases are increasing prices for certified imports, and fueling a black market for cheaper, illegal imports from China. programme.title: Iberia's Natural Border
programme.desc: Tagus International is a protected natural space shared between Spain and Portugal. Such is its diversity, it's thought that more animal and plant species live here than in all of many European countries! It's no wonder the area has been declared the first international natural park in Europe. Separated by the Tagus River, we explore the ecological differences between the Spanish and Portuguese banks of the park, and witness the sight - recorded since ancient times - of animals crossing the great river and mixing with the population found on the opposite bank. programme.title: Wildest Latin America
programme.desc: Venezuela is famous for its lost worlds – forbidding mountains, huge swamps, and impenetrable jungles, all seemingly cut off in space and time. Yet each is linked, by the waters of a mighty river: the Orinoco, the rumoured route to El Dorado, the legendary city of gold.

programme.title: Rocky Mountain Express
programme.desc: Rocky Mountain Express propels audiences on a steam train journey through the breathtaking vistas of the Canadian Rockies and relates the epic adventure of building the nation's first transcontinental railway.

programme.title: Madagascar - Land of the Chameleons
programme.desc: Traveling through Madagascar, we search for some of the most fascinating lizards on earth: the chameleon. With 59 of its 150 species known today living on Madagascar, and only there, this island can claim to be the home of the chameleon. Along the way, we also meet some of the island's humans, who capture the lizards and sell them for export, turning them into endangered species. At the climax of our voyage, we discover a unique wonder, the world's smallest chameleon, a tiny, 3-cm-long dragon!

programme.title: Plastic: The Real Sea Monster
programme.desc: Plastic floats. This is where our story begins. Millions of tonnes of plastic enter the ocean every year, from rivers and shores, ships, and platforms. The world's scientists have studied the phenomenon and come to alarming conclusions.

programme.title: Giant Sea Serpent: Meet the Myth
programme.desc: Its 10-meter length and silver ribbon shape inspired the myth of the sea serpent. Off the French Riviera, buoys set 2,000 meters deep attract pelagic species, including the Giant Oarfish—“King of Herrings”—drifting vertically, alone or in pairs. With expert guidance and passionate collaborators, a scientific expedition unveils the biology of this mysterious ambassador of the abyss.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Nigel comes face-to-face with the Philippine cobra, the most lethally venomous cobra on the planet. And in deep, dark caves on Palawan Island, the presenter searches for giant reticulated pythons sheltering from the heat of the day.

programme.title: Saving Rhino Phila
programme.desc: From deep within a conflict emerges a powerful emotional story of survival. A new breed of poachers has recently gone to war on South Africa's rhino population and against all odds; one rhino has survived their bullets. Her name is Phila.

programme.title: Green Tree Ants: Friend or Foe?
programme.desc: All over the coastal tropics of northern Australia and south east Asia, local armies of 500,000 soldiers are on standby. They wage a control war on invasive insect species.

programme.title: Food Patriots
programme.desc: Many consumers are concerned about the disconnect between food and health. Touched by their high school football player son's battle with an antibiotic resistant super-bug filmmakers Jeff and Jennifer Spitz take a closer look at what is in their food and what anyone can do to make healthier choices in their own homes, schools and communities. This film shows how one family tries to shift away from fast, processed food-like substances and toward more fresh, local and organic choices. Their many questions set the course for a journey of discovery. With humor and humility the filmmakers show how a small 10% change in what you eat and what you buy at the grocery store can lead to big results. Featuring a diverse cast, including urban farmers, chefs and athletes, the documentary celebrates a movement and educates the next generation of consumers. 'Award of Excellence' Indie Fest 2014, 'Gold Award' Oregon International Film Festival 2014, 'Humanitarian Award' Global Film Award 2014. Official Selections 2016: Oneata Film Festival, One Earth Film Festival. Official Selections 2015: Environmental Film Festival, The Village Doc Festival, Dominican Republic Environmental Film Festival, Film Ambiente Festival, Planeta. Official Selections 2014: Chipotle Sustainable Food Film Series, Wisconsin Film Festival, Duluth Film Festival, Beloit International Film Festival, Breckenridge Film Festival, Flyway Film Festival, Oregon International Film Festival and Indie Fest.

programme.title: The Challenge of Venice
programme.desc: An inextricable relationship links Venice to her salty, fresh and brackish waters, an inexhaustible resource, yet at the same time, a threat to the city's survival. Regulating the water has always formed a part of the city's history, and over the centuries has involved both major and minor interventions in the lagoon in order to maintain it's delicate balance. The real threat for Venice today is the increasing frequency of high tides and the possible constant increase of average sea levels caused by climate change. Especially at high tide, the force of the water weakens and sometimes damages the banks and the foundations of the buildings. The future of Venice lies faraway from the city, where the lagoon meets the sea, and where every day 200 million cubic metres of water flow through the port. Therefore, a decision was made to protect Venice with a massive system of Mobile Barriers: MO.S.E. (Modulo Sperimentale Elettromeccanico).

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: In many human cultures, elders play a vital role in the well-being of communities and are responsible for passing down knowledge and culture. Is it any wonder to find that the orca, the elephant, and the wolf, have been found to transmit their respective cultures to the younger generations? Young animals learn by observing their elders. Judging when to fight or take flight, deciding how to choose a life partner, learning where to find food, these are just some of the skills passed down through the generations as elders share their wisdom.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Infra-red cameras in the dead of night reveals a forest pit-viper sense and strike a target just fractionally warmer than its surroundings. Then there's the mussurana - a snake that not only eats other snakes but is immune to their venom.

programme.title: Adventure Ocean Quest: Fragile Meditarranean
programme.desc: Many of the Mediterranean's coastal waters around harbour cities like Marseille were polluted mercilessly in the past, and much of the local reef life died. Now there is change in the air: pollution has been reduced and artificial reefs encourage wildlife to return. Frederic will carry out wildlife population surveys here and oceanographer Sandrine Ruiton hopes that his results will be exceptionally accurate, since noiseless freediving is much less invasive than conventional diving methods.

programme.title: Inhabit: A permaculture Perspective
programme.desc: Inhabit: A Permaculture Perspective explores the many environmental issues facing us today and examines solutions that are being applied using the ecological design process called "permaculture"; a design method and philosophy of life with great potential for solving issues related to agriculture, economics and governance. 'Inhabit' provides an intimate look at permaculture peoples and practices ranging from rural, suburban and urban landscapes. This beautifully made documentary presents a vast array of projects, concepts and translates the diversity of permaculture into something that can be understood by an equally diverse audience. For those familiar, it will be a call to action and a glimpse into what's possible. For those unfamiliar, it will be an introduction to a new way of being and a new way of relating to the Earth. For everyone, it will be a reminder that humans are capable of being planetary healing forces. Audience Favorite Princeton Environmental Film Festival 2015. Audience Choice Award EFFY Environmental Film Festival Yale 2015. Official Selections 2015: Food + Farm Film Fest SF, G2 Green Earth Film Festival, FICMA, Life Sciences Film Festival Prague, American Conservation Film Festival, Finger Lakes Environmental Film Festival, ITSA Back to Nature Film Festival & Crossroads Festival for Documentary Film and Discourse.

programme.title: Expedition Wallacea
programme.desc: In 1850, Alfred Russell Wallace investigates the island world of the malayan archipelagos -- and discovers that the nature there is separated into two parts through a mysterious magical border. A border which still bears his name: The 'Wallace-Line.' 150 years later, a new generation of investigators travel to the mysteries Wallace-Line to investigate under water. They dive down to a mystical world, a world in which Wallace was never able to get into. The investors want to find out if a 'marine' Wallace-Line exists.

programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.title: American Beats (2025)
programme.desc: Known as the quintessential party music, Polka is alive and evolving in the great city of Milwaukee. From buttonboxes to beers and brats, this is a city full of personality and a deep love for its musical heritage.

programme.title: American Beats (2025)
programme.desc: Kansas City, Missouri, is an integral part of jazz history in America. Shaped by legends who once graced its streets, it is bursting with deep history, mouth-watering cuisine and a lively jazz scene. World-renowned trumpeter, tap dancer, and entertainer, Lonnie McFadden and celebrated singer and tap dancer Chloe McFadden, show Chunz and Makh what it’s all about. From finger-licking barbecue to sports events and a bustling nightlife, this city is a cultural hub offering endless opportunities for a fun-filled getaway.

programme.title: Changing Channels
programme.desc: Gerrard Gosens is set to become the first totally blind person to attempt the daunting 34+ km swim from Dover in the UK to Cape Gris-Nez in France. Battling the cold and unpredictable waters of the English Channel, Gerrard faces not only the rough conditions but also the need to swim in synchronization with his team of guide swimmers, Hayden, Phil, Jo, Rosie, Alexis, and Sarah by his side.

programme.title: GKA Kite-Surf World Cup Cape Verde 2026
programme.desc: The 2026 GKA Kite-Surf season once again opens in the iconic point break of Cape Verde’s Sal Island, with the title race set to be tighter than ever as it plays out over a scheduled five globe-trotting stops. A full line-up of 24 men and an expanding roster of women, with 18 athletes, from a total of 13 countries around the world are set to battle for glory in the intimidating right-hander of Ponta Preta that.

programme.title: GKA Freestyle Kite World Cup Taiba - Brazil 2025
programme.desc: The second and final call of the GKA Freestyle season is set to play out in the sumptuous conditions of Brazil’s Taíba lagoon, where the 2025 world champions will be crowned. The world championship titles are in the balance after the opening stop in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, several weeks ago, ended inconclusively when the wind declined to play ball for the freestylers. That effectively makes the GKA Freestyle Kite World Cup Taíba 2025 a one-stop world championship for the 2025 titles, leaving no margin for slip-ups from leading contenders, who are all in Brazil.

programme.title: SFT Wake Foil E-Foil World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates, will make history this autumn as it hosts the GWA Wingfoil World Cup for the first time, marking the grand finale of the 2025 FreeFly-Slalom season. Leading the charge are two-time defending world champions, Nia Suardiaz, of Spain, and Francesco Cappuzzo, of Italy, who head to Abu Dhabi leading the rankings. With the season’s final stop still wide open, both athletes will need flawless performances to secure their third consecutive titles.

programme.title: GKA Kite-Surf World Cup Taiba - Brazil 2025
programme.desc: Taíba, Brazil, host the final stop of the GKA Kite World Tour 2025. The world’s top riders will take to Taíba’s powerful Atlantic waves for four days of action-packed competition that will determine the men’s and women’s world titles. The event marks the thrilling conclusion to a season that has already visited Cape Verde, Dakhla, and Sylt.

programme.title: 2025 ROLEX New York Yacht Club Invitational Cup
programme.desc: Twenty teams from 12 countries would compete in the ninth Rolex New York Yacht Club Invitational Cup, the biennial regatta hosted by the New York Yacht Club Harbour Court in Newport, R.I. Since the event was first run in 2009, it has attracted top amateur sailors from 51 of the world’s most prestigious yacht clubs from 23 countries.

At the start of a race like the Vendée Globe, it is an adventurer who sets off.

After a two-month break, the world’s elite WingFoil riders returned to the water as the 2026 WingFoil Racing World Cup season began. The first event of the season was a historic one. For the very first time, a World Cup series event was hosted in Hong Kong, China.

programme.title: Pierra Menta 2026 Ep.1
programme.desc: La 40e édition de la Pierra Menta, qui compte également pour le championnat du monde longue distance (ISMF), a démarré sur les chapeaux de roue, animée par les duels franco- français attendus. The 40th edition of the Pierra Menta, which also counts towards the ISMF long-distance world championship, got off to a flying start, enlivened by the expected Franco-French duels.

programme.title: Pierra Menta 2026 Ep.4
programme.desc: La neige s’est invitée dans la station du Beaufortain en cette 4ᵉ et ultime étape de la Pierra Menta. Malgré des conditions météo difficiles, des milliers de spectateurs ont porté les enfants du pays, William Bon Mardion et Xavier Gachet, dans un ultime duel face à Samuel Équy et Anselme Damevin. Emily Harrop et Margot Ravinel battent les favorites Axelle Gachet-Mollaret et Célia Périllat-Pessey, au terme d’une étape qu’elles ont dominée de la tête et des jambes.Snow arrived in the Beaufortain resort for this fourth and final stage of the Pierra Menta. Despite the challenging weather conditions, thousands of spectators cheered on local favorites William Bon Mardion and Xavier Gachet in a final duel against Samuel Équy and Anselme Damevin. Emily Harrop and Margot Ravinel defeated favorites Axelle Gachet-Mollaret and Célia Périllat-Pessey, at the end of a stage they dominated from start to finish.

programme.title: Nine Mountains
programme.desc: The journey of two cyclists (Leo Russell & George Stagg) on a mission to climb the 9 most challenging and notorious mountains in Europe. From Austria To Spain, Nine Mountains is an adventure of brutality and beauty exploring the limits of the mind and body. The boys cycled over 3,200km from blistering snowstorms to scorching deserts whilst ascending the equivalent of eight times the height of Everest. The film follows a never been done route with the aim to raise £100,000 towards mens mental health charity James Place, an organisation set up to help men in suicidal crisis.

programme.title: Expedition Antarctica of extreme sports woman Caro North
programme.desc: Iceclimbing, ski mountaineering and sailing the open water for days through the infamous Drake Passage: The 28 years old extreme sports woman Caro North made her way to the very South of our continent for a four weeks expedition – accompanied by an eight-member crew. Antarctica turned out to be a paradise for extreme sports: deserted landscapes and snow-capped mountains against a surreal backdrop of ice and sea were waiting to be discovered.

programme.title: World Rookie Freeski Finals 2026
programme.desc: The World Rookie Tour is excited that the Freeski Finals are held in the magnificent Ursus Snowpark at Madonna di Campiglio. This event shows the world’s most talented young freeski athletes as they compete in one of the most celebrated snowparks in Europe. This exclusive opportunity brings the excitement and competitive spirit of one of the most anticipated events in youth action sports directly to athletes, fans and viewers. Fans from across the globe have the opportunity to witness the future of freeskiing unfold in real-time.

programme.title: Pierra Menta 2026 Ep.3
programme.desc: Au terme d’une 3e étape champagne, les coureurs de la 40e pierra menta ont régalé les centaines de spectateurs montés au sommet du Grand Mont. Le général est bouleversé par la performance d’Emily Harrop et Margot Ravinel. William Bon Mardion et Xavier Gachet résistent et confirment leur statut de favoris. At the end of a thrilling third stage, the runners of the 40th Pierra Menta delighted the hundreds of spectators who had climbed to the summit of Grand Mont. The overall standings were shaken up by the performances of Emily Harrop and Margot Ravinel. William Bon Mardion and Xavier Gachet held their own and confirmed their status as favorites.

programme.title: Nendaz Backcountry Invitational 2026
programme.desc: Nestled in the heart of the Swiss Alps, the Nendaz Backcountry Invitational by The North Face 2026 is one of the most exciting events on the freeride calendar. This unique competition brings together some of the world’s top backcountry athletes, showcasing their incredible skills and creativity in untouched snow.

programme.title: Grand Teton Loop Eng
programme.desc: Grand Teton National Park is a stunning and iconic park in the US, known for its majestic Teton Range, beautiful lakes, and diverse wildlife. In July of 2022, Jeff and Audrée made a stop on their way back to Canada while on a road trip to Colorado, so that they could run a 38 mile / 62 km loop around the park, which mile for mile would be one of the most scenic and beautiful routes theyve ever run.

programme.title: Margalef - Climbing
programme.desc: Margalef is a little village next to the Monsant river, in Catalunya. The most amazing rocks in Europe and hundreds routes for climbing. Pure fun and climbing in this little entertaining film.

programme.desc: Cris and Viv climb Piz Selva, a 2,941m mountain belonging to the Sella group, an iconic giant of the Dolomites.They start their hike from Passo Sella, and their chosen route was via Ferrata Possnecker (also called Ferrata delle Mesules), one of the oldest Via Ferratas in the Dolomites.

programme.title: Lekkarod 2026
programme.desc: Depuis 11 ans, la Lekkarod est une course majeure du mushing en Europe. Affiliée aux fédérations nationale FFST et internationale IFSS, elle est une étape de la Coupe du Monde. Chaque année, une centaine de mushers et leurs chiens prennent le départ des 9 étapes de la Lekkarod, ou de celles des Trophées !For the past 11 years, the Lekkarod has been a major mushing race in Europe. Affiliated with the national FFST and international IFSS federations, it is a stage of the World Cup. Each year, around a hundred mushers and their dogs take part in the 9 stages of the Lekkarod, or those of the Trophies!

programme.title: Alone And Without A Guide On Mexico s Third Highest Mountain-Iztaccihuatl Eng
programme.desc: Being alone and without a guide in a summit attempt for the third highest mountain in Mexico was a dream. The climb is amazing. The ridge to Iztaccihuatls summit feels endless, but the views of the surrounding valleys and Popocatepetl make the effort worth it.

programme.title: Best Via Ferrata in the Julian Alps Eng
programme.desc: Just about an hours drive from Ljubljana airport, Prisojnik, or Prisank as its also called is a beautiful 2,547m mountain in Slovenias Julian Alps.This one-day via Ferrata route is a must-do since it presents an excellent hiking and climbing challenge, but also offers all of the views youd even want. To get to its summit Cris and Viv hiked, scrambled, climbed, and even crawled on their stomachs at points, but the views in the end and the feeling of satisfaction that came after made it all worthwhile.

programme.title: Dark Peak Fell Runners
programme.desc: The Dark Peak Fell Runners base themselves in Sheffield, but their playground is the Peak District National Park where they weave tracks through the fields, peat bogs and rocky outcrops to create a tapestry of eccentricity, endeavour and endurance. As one of the biggest pure fell running clubs in the UK, the ‘Dark Peak Fell Runners’ captures the personality, quirks and successes of the club and its members. Shot throughout the course of a year, the film follows in their footsteps to reveal their well-trodden Peak District running routes including the club’s flagship race, the Edale Skyline. (Special Thanks to Pertex)

programme.title: Climbing Skye s Highest Peak - Sgurr Alasdair
programme.desc: Cris and Viv decided to climb Sgurr Alasdair, the highest mountain on the island of Skye, located in an area of the mountain range known as Black Cullin. The main challenge they had in climbing the peak was the Great Stone Chute. A 300-meter slope of the harshest mountain terrain - scree. The summit of Sgurr Alasdair has unobstructed views of all of the Munroes in the Black Cullin, and also of one of Skyes most famous routes - The Cullin Ridge traverse.

programme.title: Summiting Mt Sneffels in Colorado Eng

programme.title: UTMB KODIAK Ultra Marathon 2025

programme.title: The High
programme.desc: THE HIGH is a feature length documentary film about the making of the longest high altitude foot race in the world. The film follows the path of a group of extreme runners who individually decide to take part of a dangerous running experiment gone wrong. Indian race director Rajat Chauhan works against the advice of the military, his family and friends to create a race over the two highest passes in the world (above 17 500ft). The decline begins from the start, with runners collapsing from dehydration, hypothermia, and high-altitude sickness. And by its end finds the entire race in jeopardy and the prospect that no one finishes. Brought to life by archive footage, story recreations, and interviews, the film unfolds the events in the Himalayas of Northern India and gives a unique look into the lives of the extreme marathon runners involved. Uncovering the avalanches, athletes, and the high altitude elements. THE HIGH shows the rewards of determination, the dangers of obsession, and in the end leaves you with the answer of why they called it, the toughest race on earth. Directed by Barry Walton.

programme.title: Trail Menorca Cami De Cavalls 2025
programme.desc: Welcome to a new edition of the Trail Menorca Camí de Cavalls Conecta Balear. 185 kilometers tracing the edge of a millennia-old island, blessed with unique natural beauty. Enchanted trails, towering cliffs, and dreamlike beaches shape one of the most demanding routes in the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Norcha Eng
programme.desc: Norcha is more than a race — it’s a journey into the heart of human endurance. Set against the breathtaking landscapes of northern Portugal, Norcha follows teams of adventurers as they leave their comfort zones and confront a challenge designed to push the very limits of body and mind. Trekking, kayaking, mountain biking, rappelling — every stage forces competitors to adapt, to endure, and to discover new depths of resilience. But Norcha is not just about competition. It is about connection — with teammates, with nature, and with the spirit of exploration itself. Guided by values of solidarity, humility, and dedication, this odyssey reveals that the greatest victories are not only measured at the finish line, but in the moments of transformation along the way.

programme.title: Ungrounded Episode 3 - Meredith Edwards
programme.desc: Meredith Edwards is an elite-level mountain ultra runner, with podium finishes at the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc TDS race, the Javelina Jundred 100K and the Flagstaff Skyrace 55K. She is also a member of the U.S. Ski Mountaineering Team. In Episode 3, she reveals how in 2019 she fought an inner struggle with her body that almost resulted in a full blood transfusion-and came back from it to win one of the world’s most challenging Ultra Marathons. (English version with French, German, Italian and Spanish subtitles available)

programme.title: Florence Marathon - We run in art Eng

programme.desc: Since its founding, the Challenge Family triathlon series has redefined the spirit of endurance sports. programme.title: The First Second - Michi Wohlleben

On the other hand his words create beautiful images that show Michis inspiration, fluidity, and pleasure in action. Through the discovery of his goals and his gamble with the risk, Michi mixes both quest and primal pleasure.

programme.title: The First Second - Michi Wohlleben
programme.desc: «The higher you raise the bar the further you fall down!”. Michi language is made of very strong, singular sentences, as sharpened as his climbing style. His sentences try to define himself, without worrying about himself, by thwarting clichés… but do not succeed in really finding himself. On the other hand his words create beautiful images that show Michis inspiration, fluidity, and pleasure in action. Through the discovery of his goals and his gamble with the risk, Michi mixes both quest and primal pleasure.

programme.title: Cape To Cape 2025 Eng
programme.desc: 800 riders have assembled for the 17th edition of the Australian Cape To Cape mountain bike stage race. Starting at Cape Leeuwin lighthouse and finishing four days later up at Cape Naturaliste, the course makes its way through a network of trails along the coast, through National Parks, forest, farm lands, mountain bike parks, and bush before heading up to the northern cape of the South West WA region. Roughly 200km and 2,500m of climbing in total, each day’s riding is between 34km and 59km and has its own special terrain and environment to keep things interesting with a mix of fast flowing single trail, farm tracks, groomed downhill trails and fire trails.

programme.title: Inside Sailing 2026 - Episode 2
programme.desc: We will start this episode from Malaysia, where the 22nd Royal Langkawi International Regatta took place in January. We will continue with the WingFoil discipline.The previous WingFoil Racing World Cup season ended in Brazil, followed by a two-month break before the new season began. Before seeing what happened in the first event of 2026, let’s have a look at both the Formula Wing European and World Championships. The Formula Wing World Championships, taking place in Cagliari in the south of Sardinia, attracted 93 riders from 22 different nations of the most important event of the 2025 season. After a two-month break, the world’s elite WingFoil riders returned to the water as the 2026 WingFoil Racing World Cup season began. The first event of the season was a historic one. programme.desc: Starting this episode, we are visiting Oman for the IODA Asia & Oceania Championship 2025, a leading youth sailing event that attracts hundreds of participants each year. The 55th Trofeo Princesa Sofia Mallorca by FERGUS Hotels, as the first scoring event for the 2026 Sailing Grand Slam. Sailing Grand Slam, developed in close collaboration with World Sailing, is an international series of elite Olympic watersport events, uniting all 10 Olympic disciplines –across sailing, windsurfing and kiteboarding– into one integrated Grand Prix-style circuit in Europe and the United States. Following the event in Palma, the next event is Semaine Olympique Française in Hyeres.

programme.title: Dark Peak Fell Runners
programme.desc: The Dark Peak Fell Runners base themselves in Sheffield, but their playground is the Peak District National Park where they weave tracks through the fields, peat bogs and rocky outcrops to create a tapestry of eccentricity, endeavour and endurance. As one of the biggest pure fell running clubs in the UK, the ‘Dark Peak Fell Runners’ captures the personality, quirks and successes of the club and its members. Shot throughout the course of a year, the film follows in their footsteps to reveal their well-trodden Peak District running routes including the club’s flagship race, the Edale Skyline. programme.title: Lekkarod 2026

Chaque année, une centaine de mushers et leurs chiens prennent le départ des 9 étapes de la Lekkarod, ou de celles des Trophées !For the past 11 years, the Lekkarod has been a major mushing race in Europe. Affiliated with the national FFST and international IFSS federations, it is a stage of the World Cup. Each year, around a hundred mushers and their dogs take part in the 9 stages of the Lekkarod, or those of the Trophies!

programme.title: World Rookie Freeski Finals 2026

This exclusive opportunity brings the excitement and competitive spirit of one of the most anticipated events in youth action sports directly to athletes, fans and viewers. Fans from across the globe have the opportunity to witness the future of freeskiing unfold in real-time.

programme.title: A Feather in the West
programme.desc: In September 2019, a team of talented Irish climbers [Chloe Condron, Kevin Kilroy, Michelle OLoughlin and Conor McGovern] travelled to the small island of Owey to explore sea cliffs that local guidebook writer Iain Miller claims, have “enough new routing potential to last at least twelve lifetimes”. ‘A Feather in the West’ is a film about their trad climbing experiences and the relatively niche pursuit of first ascents, set on the Wild Atlantic Way, off the west coast of County Donegal. (Special thanks to Pertex)

programme.title: Best Via Ferrata in the Julian Alps Eng
programme.desc: Just about an hours drive from Ljubljana airport, Prisojnik, or Prisank as its also called is a beautiful 2,547m mountain in Slovenias Julian Alps.This one-day via Ferrata route is a must-do since it presents an excellent hiking and climbing challenge, but also offers all of the views youd even want. To get to its summit Cris and Viv hiked, scrambled, climbed, and even crawled on their stomachs at points, but the views in the end and the feeling of satisfaction that came after made it all worthwhile.
